title: Fix 'Failed to create sink input: sink is suspended' error
summary: If you receive errors about a suspended sink and have no sound, deleting user-specific PulseAudio folders often resolves the issue.
error_patterns: Failed to create sink input: sink is suspended

steps.explain: Remove user-specific PulseAudio configuration and cookie files. This forces PulseAudio to recreate them.

rollback.explain: Restore configuration from backup if available. Otherwise, PulseAudio will use defaults.

warnings: This will reset per-application volume settings.
